test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following programmes was launched by NABARD in 2015 to promote the livelihood of the people in both farm and off-farm activities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**LEDP**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Livelihood Enterprise Development Programme:-**

 
 
• **NABARD launched the Livelihood Enterprise Development Programme (LEDP) in 2015 to promote the livelihood of people in both farm and off-farm activities. **
 
• LEDP provides financial assistance and capacity building to individuals and groups for setting up and running small enterprises.
 
• LEDP focuses on promoting entrepreneurship and income generation among rural youth, women, and marginalized communities.
 
• LEDP also aims to enhance the productivity and competitiveness of small and micro-enterprises in rural areas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **LWE (Left Wing Extremism):-**

 
 
• It is a government initiative to address the issue of Maoist insurgency in certain parts of India.
 
 
 
• **MEDP (Micro Enterprise Development Programme):-**
 
 
• It is a scheme of NABARD to provide financial assistance to micro-enterprises.
 
 
 
• **BLP (Bank Linkage Programme);- **
 
 
• **​**It was launched in early 1990s.
 
• The programme was started at the initiative of NABARD in 1992 to link the unorganised sector with the formal banking sector.
